_fragment.name: sample-image-tags
_fragment.description: Vision tagging using the existing Qwen 3.5 LLM and an explicit sample image input.

prompt.default: Describe the visible artistic style of this image using exactly 4 or 5 distinct short tags. Prefer medium, technique, palette, texture, lighting or composition; avoid subject names and artist guesses. Return only a JSON object with a tags array, for example {"tags":["watercolor","muted palette","loose brushwork","soft edges"]}. Each tag should be 1-4 words, lowercase. If the image cannot be assessed or no reliable visual style tags can be identified, return {"tags":[]} instead of inventing tags.
